title: Church Worship
definition: Church Worship is the gathered response of God's people to His glory through Word, prayer, praise, ordinances, giving, and obedient devotion.
summary: Church Worship is the gathered response of God's people to His glory through Word, prayer, praise, ordinances, giving, and obedience.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the mediator of worship and the center of the Church's praise.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on the Godward purpose of the Church's assembly. Worship is not performance for consumers; it is reverent, joyful response to the triune God. The Church is formed as it beholds God's worth and responds according to His Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because church life can become centered on preference, production, or personality. Worship re-centers the congregation on God Himself. It also shapes the heart by teaching believers what is worthy of love, fear, trust, and praise.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Come to worship to honor God, not merely to evaluate a service. Let Scripture, prayer, song, and the ordinances form your affections. Ask whether your personal preferences are submitted to God's glory.
